name: marktplaats-mcp
description: Marktplaats (automotive): search_listings, get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_marktplaats_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MARKTPLAATS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_marktplaats_client_id.description: Client id assigned by Marktplaats (API clients are registered by the platform for business/advertiser use); grant_type=client_credentials at https://auth.marktplaats.nl/accounts/oauth/token.

platform_mcp_marktplaats_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MARKTPLAATS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_marktplaats_client_secret.description: Client secret assigned with it. A client token reaches public resources (categories, search, advertisements) only.

platform_mcp_marktplaats_category_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MARKTPLAATS_CATEGORY_ID
platform_mcp_marktplaats_category_id.description: Category id to restrict searches to (e.g. the cars category id from GET /v1/categories); without it `query` is mandatory.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: GET /v1/search?query&categoryId&postCode&offset&limit (limit ≤ 200, offset a multiple of limit, offset*limit ≤ 5000); query supports and/or and '-' negation; 400 query-missing when neither query nor categoryId is given. location is a 6-character Dutch/Belgian postcode. make/model/year/price filters are not query parameters (the documented price filter lives in a GET request body, which is not sent). priceModel.askingPrice is in EURO CENTS and stays in raw.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: GET /v1/advertisements/{itemId} (ids like m1234): title, description, categoryId, priceModel (euro cents), attributes and image links in raw.
